select a.id,a.name,a.is_deleted from product_line a left join project_product_line b on a.id=b.product_line_id where b.project_id = #{projectId} and b.is_deleted = false and a.id is not null

select b.project_id,c.id product_line_id,c.name productLineName,c.is_deleted,d.name bizDomainName from project_product_line b left join product_line c on b.product_line_id=c.id left join biz_domain d on c.biz_domain_id=d.id

#{item}

select a.id product_line_id,a.name productLineName,b.name bizDomainName from product_line a left join biz_domain b on a.biz_domain_id=b.id where a.id = #{id}

select id, biz_domain_id, name, owner, owner_id,bug_online_owner_id,bug_online_owner, is_deleted, create_man_id, create_man, create_date, modify_man_id, modify_man, modify_date from product_line where biz_domain_id = #{bizDomainId} and is_deleted = false
